videos.title: 15-Year-Old Alone on a Flipped Boat for 2 Days (True Story)
videos.description:
In September 2026, a 15-year-old boy from a tiny village on St. Lawrence Island, Alaska, went halibut fishing with his older brother and his cousin. On Saturday night their 18-foot skiff flipped in the Bering Sea. For almost two days, in water around 50°F, he knelt on the overturned hull, alone, until a Coast Guard pilot happened to look out the window at the right angle of sun.

videos.title: A 5-Year-Old Fell 49 Feet Into the Ocean. Then Her Dad Jumped.
videos.description:
On June 29, 2025, a five-year-old girl fell 49 feet from Deck 4 of a cruise ship into the open ocean. Her father jumped in after her — less than a minute later — and kept her above the water for 20 minutes with two fractures in his spine, while the ship made a huge turn to come back for them.

This is the true story of what happened, minute by minute, based on the police report and news coverage.
